about: Sourced Accra facts used for game content (Accra We Dey). Prices are reference points for tuning, not live values; in-game prices are deliberately game-balanced. Retrieved 2026-10-29.

facts.fact: Accra uses GMT/UTC+0 all year with no daylight saving, so the server's UTC day is the Accra day.
Harmattan: dry, dusty Saharan wind roughly December to February/March, visibility can drop to about 1 km.
Two rainy seasons: major rains about April to June (peaking May-June), minor rains about September to October/November.

Greater Accra average temperature roughly 27.7 C; about 29 C in April, 27 C in June, 26 C in September, 28.6 C in November (Meteostat via KKday); daytime highs about 32 C in April and 29 C in June (weather2travel).

2026 statutory holidays include New Year (1 Jan), Constitution Day (7 Jan), Independence Day (6 Mar), Labour Day (1 May), Republic Day (1 Jul), Founders' Day (21 Sep), Farmers' Day (first Friday of December), Christmas (25 Dec), Boxing Day (26 Dec). Eid dates depend on moon sighting.
Independence Day parades centre on Independence Square / Black Star Square.
Chale Wote street art festival takes over Jamestown each August; free to attend.
Homowo is the Ga harvest festival, usually August (sometimes July/September), with kpokpoi and palm soup.
Detty December: peak festival/party season in Accra (Afro Nation Ghana, AfroFuture, Detty Rave); lodging prices rise sharply.
Trotro fares rose 8% from 26 September 2026 after GPRTU/GRTCC consultations with the Ministry of Transport.
Reported 2026 Accra fares: Circle to Lapaz up to GH₵8 (from GH₵5.60); Atomic Junction to Sakumono Estate Junction GH₵13 (from GH₵11).
